title: CSI-JEPA: Towards Foundation Representations for Ubiquitous Wi-Fi Sensing with Minimal Supervision
abstract: arXiv:2605.14171v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Channel state information (CSI) provides a widely available sensing modality for human and environment perception, but existing CSI sensing models usually rely on task-specific supervised training and require substantial labeled data for each task, device, user, or environment. This limits their scalability in practical deployments where unlabeled CSI is abundant but labeled data is costly to collect. In this paper, we present CSI-JEPA, a self-supervised predictive representation learning framework for label-efficient and transferable Wi-Fi sensing. CSI-JEPA learns reusable temporal-spectral representations from unlabeled CSI samples by predicting latent features of masked channel regions from visible context. To better match the physical structure of CSI, it jointly tokenizes CSI along the time and subcarrier dimensions and introduces a channel variation-aware masking strategy that prioritizes regions with stronger local channel dyn

translated_title: CSI-JEPA：以最小监督迈向普适Wi-Fi感知的基础表征
translated_abstract: 信道状态信息（CSI）为人类和环境感知提供了一种广泛可用的感知模态，但现有的CSI感知模型通常依赖任务特定的监督训练，且针对每个任务、设备、用户或环境都需要大量标注数据。这限制了它们在实际部署中的可扩展性，因为在实际场景中未标注的CSI数据非常丰富，而标注数据的收集成本高昂。本文提出了CSI-JEPA，一个面向标签高效且可迁移的Wi-Fi感知的自监督预测表征学习框架。CSI-JEPA通过从可见上下文预测被掩码信道区域的潜在特征，从未标注的CSI样本中学习可复用的时频谱表征。为了更好地匹配CSI的物理结构，该方法沿时间和子载波两个维度联合对CSI进行分词，并引入了一种信道变化感知的掩码策略，优先选择具有更强局部信道动态性的区域……
tldr: CSI-JEPA是一个自监督预测表征学习框架，通过时间-子载波联合分词和信道变化感知掩码策略，从未标注CSI中学习可迁移的Wi-Fi感知表征，大幅降低对标注数据的依赖。
